title: Read a checkbox state
summary: The prop method reads a live element property.
introduction: The prop method reads a live element property. Your task: Check and uncheck the box before reading it.
learningObjectives: Check and uncheck the box before reading it.
Explain the example for read a checkbox state

blocks.text: The prop method reads a live element property. A checkbox's checked property tells whether it is checked now.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: `prop("checked")` reads the checkbox's current true-or-false state rather than only its original markup.

blocks.text: The console shows true or false for the current check state.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The checked HTML attribute describes an initial state. Use the property for the current state.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Check and uncheck the box before reading it.
